name: Duck pho
summary: Phở vịt is the hot duck bowl beside phở chua. Báo Cao Bằng describes soft noodles, firm duck, and a rich broth. A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Cao Bang city, in the morning.
howToEat: Báo Cao Bằng on 1 September 2026: soft noodles, fragrant firm duck, a rich broth, and the smell of spices and roast duck. The 3 May 2026 article calls the broth fragrant and rich, and sets this bowl beside phở chua as the warmer one.
The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism on 22 August 2024 names phở vịt quay in a list and does not describe a second bowl. A stall hour and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Cao Bang city, at breakfast, on the 1 September 2026 day. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
